fields.Name: User Routine Dispatcher
fields.Description: Every-minute sweep that claims and executes due user routines (MJ: User Routines) — the single dispatcher behind the User Routines feature. Claims each due routine by advancing NextRunAt BEFORE running so an overlapping pass can never double-run it; ConcurrencyMode=Skip additionally prevents two dispatcher sweeps from running concurrently across servers. Routine-level failures are isolated and recorded on their MJ: User Routine Runs rows — the sweep itself only fails on infrastructure errors.
